title: Matchmaker with OpenTelemetry tracing across services
name: Matchmaker tracing setup

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code propagates and records traces? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
What does the sampler configured in InitTracing do for this service?
choices: Samples 10 percent of root traces by trace ID, and follows the sampling decision of the incoming parent when there is one
Samples 10 percent of all spans independently, so a trace can have gaps
Always samples spans that record an error, regardless of the ratio
Samples every trace but exports only 10 percent in the batcher

questions.prompt: In loadCandidate, why do the two goroutines use gctx rather than ctx?
choices: gctx carries a new span for each goroutine automatically
It cancels the sibling request as soon as one call fails, while still carrying the parent span from ctx so the downstream calls are children of loadCandidate
The errgroup requires its own context to be able to recover panics
Without gctx the two goroutines would share a single HTTP connection

questions.prompt: Both loadCandidate and Enqueue call RecordError and SetStatus when an error occurs. What is the effect on the trace?
choices: SetStatus stops the span from ending, so duplicates are merged on export
The second call overwrites the first and the trace shows only one error
The error is recorded as an event on each span and each span is marked as failed, so the failure is visible at both levels of the trace
RecordError automatically marks the span as failed, so SetStatus is redundant
